group_manifest.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1, select the anchor's first occurrence, recursively split xizi_dllseg, derive the pure insert-before equation, and use list_snoc_destruct on the prefix to expose either the sentinel predecessor or the final data-node predecessor. For return_wit_1, rewrite nodes_before=prefix0++[prev], fold updated fields into prev->inserted->anchor links, join with prefix0 and suffix, and close the DLL. For return_wit_2, substitute the empty-prefix boundary equations, use inserted as the new first node, prepend inserted/anchor to the suffix, and close the DLL. Derive address inequalities from separated field ownership without any forbidden logical-equivalence lemma. Keep decomposition/join facts local; no case_lib helper is needed.
